what: Planned review-core integration cannot exercise the emit-tally skip guard or tally producer normalization

suggested_fix: For the FINDING_1 case either wire real tally-code-votes.sh and emit-tally.sh (minimal ballot/voter/collect fixture) or drop the test-review-core extension and rely on the already-planned test-emit-tally.sh and test-tally-code-votes.sh unit coverage
